test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All doctors are players.

2. Some players are teachers.

**Conclusions:**

1. Some players are doctors as well as teachers.

2. All teachers are players.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f97d757285ab7fe4bb44f4253674a664da61063d2a5ccf80c077a5a0a350d7c5.png] 

Conclusions:

1. Some players are doctors as well as teachers. → False (it is possible but not definite)

2. All teachers are players. → False (it is possible but not definite)

Hence, 'Neither conclusion 1 nor 2 follows'.
